summary: Invitation Homes Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its operating partnership issued $500M aggregate principal of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2032 in an underwritten public offering. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the company and certain subsidiaries. The purchase price was 98.691% of par. This is a routine debt issuance creating a direct financial obligation; it is not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains standard covenants and guarantee provisions. No special-situation event is present.
